description: Concordance des personnes et des temps, repères. 10 exercices du livret + 34 questions de cours.

questions.question: Peter Jennings said he would visit the factory as soon as he ____ released from hospital.
questions.explication: Subordonnée de temps au prétérit (complétive au conditionnel présent).

questions.question: They were sure that after his long and tiring walk in the woods, the gardener ____ a nap when they arrived.
questions.explication: Circonstancielle de temps au prétérit : complétive au conditionnel présent.

questions.question: Mrs. Woodrige asked us what time we ____ we would bring the bulk goods.
questions.explication: Complétive au conditionnel : thought (prétérit) est cohérent avec asked.

questions.question: Paul Hutchinson declared that as long as the survey had not been finished he ____ any information.
questions.explication: Subordonnée de temps au pluperfect : complétive au conditionnel présent (would not release).

questions.question: Joe Stevens wonders whether anybody ____ that information on time.
questions.explication: Principale au présent : complétive au futur.

questions.question: They were sorry to hear that the drought ____ many crops in the region.
questions.explication: Principale au prétérit : complétive au pluperfect (action antérieure).

questions.question: The real estate agent advised the landlord to install a fitted kitchen so that the rental ____ faster.
questions.explication: Principale au prétérit : complétive au conditionnel présent.

questions.question: The sales representative apologizes about bringing the wrong samples and promises he ____ the right ones next time.
questions.explication: Principale au présent + next time : futur.

questions.question: The captain regretted that the propeller ____ during the competition and added he would come back next year with a brand new ship.
questions.explication: Principale au prétérit : pluperfect (le regret est postérieur à la casse).

questions.question: The children had always thought Santa Claus ____ them another board game.
questions.explication: Principale au pluperfect : le conditionnel est envisageable dans la subordonnée.

questions.question: Le discours indirect rapporte :
Verbes introducteurs du discours indirect :
questions.explication: Aussi answer, beg, command, decide, declare, deny, explain, inquire, object, order, plead, regret, remind, reply, request, require, say, suggest, tell, want to know.

questions.question: La proposition principale du discours direct devient, au discours indirect :
Avec un sujet identique (le sujet répète ses propres paroles), le pronom :
questions.explication: I say that I've been busy all day.

questions.question: Avec un sujet différent, on modifie :
questions.explication: I've been busy all day → She is saying she has been busy all day.

questions.question: « My glasses are darker than yours » → He is saying that ____ glasses are darker than yours.
« Mine are safe » → He is saying that ____ are safe.
Principale au présent : la complétive :
Principale au passé : la complétive :
choix: se met au passé à un degré supérieur (recul d'un temps)

questions.question: Présent → (principale au passé) :
questions.explication: « I know all his songs » → He said (that) he knew all his songs.

questions.question: Prétérit → (principale au passé) :
Futur (will) → (principale au passé) :
questions.explication: « I will know » → He said he would know.

questions.question: Présent continu → :
Impératif → :
questions.explication: « Learn his songs! » → She told me to learn his songs.

questions.question: « Don't purchase this hat » → I advise you ____ this hat.
« Must » au style direct devient au style indirect :
questions.explication: I said (that) I must / had to know all his songs.

questions.question: « May » au présent → présent :
choix: I am saying (that) I may know all his songs
I am saying (that) I might have

questions.question: Phrase interrogative directe → discours indirect :
choix: ordre des mots de la déclarative (pas d'inversion)
questions.explication: Where did you buy these earrings? → I wanted to know where she had bought these earrings.

questions.question: « Would you do that for me? » →
choix: I asked her if she would do that for me
I asked her would she do that for me
I asked her if would she do that for me
I asked if she will do

questions.question: Now (discours direct) devient au discours indirect :
Until now devient :
Today devient :
Tomorrow / next day devient :
choix: the following day / the day after / the next day

questions.question: Yesterday devient :
choix: the day before / the previous day

questions.question: The day after tomorrow devient :
The day before yesterday devient :
choix: two days before / two days earlier

questions.question: Last week devient :
Ago devient :
Here devient :
This devient :
These devient :
Les changements de repères temporels/spatiaux ont lieu quand :
choix: le verbe introductif est au passé
le verbe introductif est au présent

questions.question: Dans une complétive au discours indirect, on utilise l'ordre des mots :
She asked him when he ____ learning his songs by heart.
